summary: Brickpoint’s first-property design should prioritize a simple, role-based experience; manually supervised maintenance assignment; resident self-service for applications, payments, maintenance and rentable items; custom lease packets; and strong protection of sensitive resident data. Several detailed financial, payment, renewal and call-routing policies still require confirmation before configuration.

settings.setting: Create separate groups for site/leasing staff, maintenance supervisors and technicians, property managers, accounting, and system administrators.
settings.proposed: Configure role-based groups with simplified dashboards and permissions appropriate to each team.
settings.confirmText: Likely role-based groups for site/leasing, maintenance, property management, accounting, and system administration — confirm with client: Which named employees belong in each launch group?
settings.meaning: Each employee sees only the tools and information needed for their job.
settings.assumption: Brickpoint wants the demonstrated role-specific dashboards and does not want most employees to have broad administrative access.
reasoning: Kevin praised the simplified leasing dashboard and said it would fit most office staff.
Howard and Kathy agreed accounting users should have a different view.
Maintenance assignment responsibilities vary by property, so maintenance supervisors and designated office administrators need a distinct group.

callsUsed.brief: Seth, Brock and Vincent from Entrata, along with Howard from Brickpoint Properties, Inc., discussed Entrata's accounting functionalities, including customizable dashboards, vendor management with automated compliance and invoice processing, and robust job costing and fixed asset tracking. Key features like flexible GL management, customizable reporting with unit-level tagging, and efficient bank reconciliations were highlighted, addressing Brickpoint's pain points with their current system. The conversation concluded with plans for a follow-up meeting to delve into Entrata's lead-to-lease process and an in-person demo for executive leadership in November, after Brickpoint identifies their top two software contenders by Halloween.

callsUsed.title: Brickpoint + Entrata | Meeting 4 (Lead-Lease Process)
callsUsed.brief: Brock and Seth from Entrata, along with Charles from Brickpoint Properties, Inc., discussed the Entrata platform’s lead-to-lease workflow, including automated screening, lease generation, and resident portal features. Seth committed to investigating administrative access restrictions for sensitive data, while Howard and Brock agreed to coordinate a follow-up pricing discussion to evaluate the potential transition of Brickpoint Properties, Inc. to the Entrata system.
